title: Characterizing the Temporal, Emotional, and Social Patterns of Adolescent Substance Use Discussions on Reddit
task: Thematic analysis of adolescent substance-use posts combined with temporal and emotion analysis
problem: Surveys under-report adolescent substance use; keyword and lexicon methods miss informal, emotionally nuanced adolescent language.
architecture: Hour-by-day temporal heatmaps; TF-IDF + LinearSVC for 3-class sentiment and 7-class emotion; BERTopic with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 sentence embeddings, topics labelled manually from keywords and representative posts.
metrics: posting volume by hour and weekday
key_results: Sentiment: 47.5% positive, 46.5% negative, 6.0% neutral posts; sadness and fear dominate emotions.
Largest BERTopic topics: Teen Relationship 11.23%, Marijuana Use 10.28%, Alcohol Issues 6.59%, Teen Vaping 5.99%.
Posting peaks at weekends and between about 9 PM and 2 AM.
strengths: Joins topic modelling with time-of-day and emotion signals on one corpus.
Uses contextual embeddings suited to short, informal posts.

limitations.text: Reddit users are not representative of all adolescents; posts are self-expression, not verified behaviour.
Classifiers may misread sarcasm and slang; topic modelling cannot establish causal relations.
No topic coherence/diversity score or comparison with another topic model is reported; several topic labels do not match their listed keywords (e.g. 'Marijuana Use' with keywords 'Girl, friend').

notes: Limitations section calls the classifiers transformer-based, while the method section describes TF-IDF + LinearSVC.
